Sheet 01 / 07

Profile

Summary
Field

Site inspection & QA/QC

Office

Civil 3D & AutoCAD modeling

Akhila is a civil engineering professional spanning field operations, water and wastewater systems design support, civil CAD drafting, and project administration. She delivers AutoCAD and Civil 3D-based design outputs for grading, servicing, stormwater, watermain, and sanitary sewer projects, and supports multidisciplinary engineering teams through design coordination, field verification, construction documentation, and technical reporting. She interprets drawings and specifications for field crews, coordinates subcontractor work and material deliveries, and enforces quality control on-site — then carries that same detail into the office for cost tracking, scheduling, and bid support. Her technical toolkit runs across Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Revit, and Bluebeam, and her fieldwork spans residential site servicing in Ontario and municipal infrastructure delivery in India. She holds a valid Ontario driver's license and is fully flexible for site rotation across Eastern Canada.
